summary: Full E2E backend + frontend testing for Smart Eye Hub. All 22 backend pytest tests PASS after fixing a Purchase/Expense date validation bug. Frontend mobile UI verified: manager & employee login, dashboard rendering, tabs, Documents filter chips, doc-create flow (quotation created with correct totals AED 367.50), PDF download button, role-based quick actions (employee correctly hidden from Quotation/Invoice/Receipt), More screen and logout-btn-more. React Native style deprecation warnings detected in console (non-blocking): resizeMode, pointerEvents, shadow* — recommend main agent migrate to props.resizeMode / style.pointerEvents / boxShadow.

minor.issue: FIXED by test agent — model required `date: str` but create body sent date=None which overrode default_factory causing 500. Patched to strip None date from body dict before Pydantic instantiation.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning: 'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated. Please use props.resizeMode.' — search for Image components using resizeMode in style and move to prop.
Deprecation warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — replace pointerEvents={...} prop with style={{pointerEvents:'...'}}.
Deprecation warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — replace shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius with boxShadow (or keep Platform.select for iOS/Android).

action_items: Optional: migrate deprecated RN style props (resizeMode, pointerEvents, shadow*) to remove console warnings.

Review the backend fix applied by test agent in server.py (create_purchase, create_expense) — filters out `date=None` from body before Pydantic instantiation. Consider making Purchase.date/Expense.date Optional or generating default before model creation as a cleaner design.
Consider limiting seed test data cleanup — many TEST_ documents were left in DB during testing (quotations SE-QT-2026-001..010, etc.).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1200 lines; consider splitting into modules (auth, docs, pdf) for maintainability.
PDF endpoints return base64-encoded JSON which is fine for mobile but is 33% larger than binary; acceptable trade-off.
DocBase model missing server-side validation that items list is non-empty for quotations/invoices (currently allows empty totals=0).
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed customers, inventory item, works, quotations (10), invoice, receipt, service report, purchase, expense, material request during testing. Not cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base = EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL + /api. Auth via POST /api/auth/login returning {access_token, user}. Seed manager Manager@123, employee Employee@123. Quotation/Invoice/Receipt creation requires manager role. Service Report / Expense / Material Request allowed for employee. Purchase/Expense create bodies allow date=None and the server strips it before Pydantic (fix already applied). Frontend testIDs pattern: stat-*, qa-*, docs-tab-*, docs-fab, doc-customer-name, item-desc-{i}, item-qty-{i}, item-price-{i}, doc-save-btn, pdf-download-btn, back-btn, logout-btn, logout-btn-more, more-inventory/expenses/customers/material-requests, sel-cust-{customerId}.
